newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Picky thieves make off with tons of fine coffee.
newsitem.headline: Picky thieves make off with tons of fine coffee.

text.p: A large gang of armed men stole 130 tons of coffee from a huge Brazilian warehouse, taking seven hours to carry out the meticulous heist in which only the finest beans were selected, news reports said on Saturday.
The gang made off with close to $300,000 worth of coffee and used four trucks to haul their take away, TV Globo reported.

Globo said about 20 men armed with machine guns participated in the operation, which began late on Friday and ended early on Saturday. The warehouse is located in a small town in the north central state of Para.
Police could not be reached to confirm the report.
About 2,000, 130-pound (60 kg) bags of coffee were taken from the warehouse, which holds about 530,000 bags, Globo said.
Workers, who were held hostage during the robbery, told Globo that the men carefully selected the best bags of coffee and appeared not to be worried about the time.
